Deliver a documented normal example/companion entry usable on demand with existing personal local runtime; label it replay of saved real model results, not live cross-client streaming or main Codex graphical adoption. Reproduction cannot require new model calls or private originals.

Zero new model starts/attempts/API/entitlement calls, no new global configuration/trust/registration or runtime release solely for evidence. Preserve all old budgets and failures, own temporary resource closure and external task outcomes.
